app "Exam prep" school plum
table question q text, a text, b text, c text, right pick A|B|C, topic text, note text?
table attempt question ref question, chose pick A|B|C
setting exam date = today "Exam date"
exam - today "days to the exam" big

each question as x
  stack card gap 1
    x.q bold

      button x.a tap add attempt question = x, chose = A
      button x.b tap add attempt question = x, chose = B

each question by topic
  if sum(it, count(it.attempt where chose != question.right)) > 0

      it.key grow
      sum(it, count(it.attempt where chose != question.right)) "wrong"
form question, "Add question from my notes"

- text: exam minus today, "days to the exam".
- text: "Practice score", how many of the attempt have its chose is its question right, "of", how many attempt entries.
- for each question:
  - text: the q of the question.
  - a button the a of the question; a tap adds a attempt with question set to the question, chose set to A.
  - a button the b of the question; a tap adds a attempt with question set to the question, chose set to B.
  - a button the c of the question; a tap adds a attempt with question set to the question, chose set to C.
- text: "Weak topics".
- for each group of question entries by topic:
  - if the sum of how many its attempt entries where chose is not the right of the question over the the group is more than 0:
    - text: its key.
    - text: the sum of how many its attempt entries where chose is not the right of the question over the the group, "wrong".

app "Installments" calc ocean
state price money = 0
state down money = 0
state months num = 12
state rate num = 10
field price "Price"
field down "Down payment"
"Months" months head
slider months 3..60
"Flat percent per year" rate head

- borrowed is the larger of price minus down and 0.

Shows:
- a box to fill in price, labelled "Price".
- a box to fill in down, labelled "Down payment".
- text: "Months", months.
- a slider for months from 3 to 60.
- text: "Flat percent per year", rate.
- a slider for rate from 0 to 40.
- text: "Monthly", total divided by the larger of months and 1 rounded.
- text: "Total to pay", total rounded.

program:
app "Pool" game slate
table point team pick Dad|Son, pts num 1..500 = 1
let a = sum(point.pts where team = Dad)
let b = sum(point.pts where team = Son)
setting winat num = 7 "Play to"
row gap 2
  stack card grow align center
    "Dad" bold
    a big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Dad, pts = 1
    row gap 1
      button "+2" tap add point team = Dad, pts = 2
  stack card grow align center
    "Son" bold
    b big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Son, pts = 1
    row gap 1
      button "+2" tap add point team = Son, pts = 2
button "Undo" tap remove last(point)
button "New game" tap remove all point
if a >= winat
  "Dad win!" head color good
if b >= winat
  "Son win!" head color good
"Lead:" abs(a - b) faint
list point
describe:
Pool, in the slate colours.
Keeps:
- point: team: one of Dad, Son; pts: number, 1 to 500, starts at 1. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Play to": number, starts at 7.
Works out:
- a is the total pts of point where team is Dad.
- b is the total pts of point where team is Son.
Shows:
- text: "Dad".
- text: a.
- a button "+1"; a tap adds a point with team set to Dad, pts set to 1.
- a button "+2"; a tap adds a point with team set to Dad, pts set to 2.
- text: "Son".
- text: b.
- a button "+1"; a tap adds a point with team set to Son, pts set to 1.
- a button "+2"; a tap adds a point with team set to Son, pts set to 2.
- a button "Undo"; a tap removes the latest point entries, with undo.
- a button "New game"; a tap removes all point entries, with one undo.
- if a is at least winat:
  - text: "Dad win!".
- if b is at least winat:
  - text: "Son win!".
- text: "Lead:", a minus b without its sign.
- a list of point; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.

program:
app "Milk shop" milk slate
table customer name text, rate money "Rate per litre"
table delivery customer ref customer, litres num 0..
table payment customer ref customer, amount money
state m date = today
monthnav m
count(customer) "customers," sum(delivery today, it.litres) "litres delivered today" head
each customer as c
  let bill = sum(c.delivery month of m, it.litres) * c.rate
  stack card gap 1
    row
      c.name bold grow
      "Bill" bill bold
    "Paid" sum(c.payment.amount month of m) ", left" bill - sum(c.payment.amount month of m) faint
    row gap 1
      each [0.5, 1, 2] as v
        button v "L" tap add delivery customer = c, litres = v
form customer, "Add customer"
form payment, "Payment received"
list delivery month of m by day
describe:

Remembers while you use it: m, starting at today.

- arrows that move m back and forward one month.
- text: how many customer entries, "customers,", the sum of its litres over the delivery today, "litres delivered today".
- for each customer:
  - text: the name of the customer.
  - text: "Bill", bill.
  - text: "Paid", the total amount of the customer's payment entries in the month of m, ", left", bill minus the total amount of the customer's payment entries in the month of m.
  - for 0.5, 1, 2:
    - a button the value, "L"; a tap adds a delivery with customer set to the customer, litres set to the value.

program:
app "Ramadan Planner" moon ocean
table day d date, sehri time, iftar time, roza bool = yes "Roza kept", rakaat num 0..20 = 8 "Taraweeh rakaat", note text?
form day, "Add day"
each day sort d
  row card tap edit it
    stack grow
      it.d bold
      "Sehri" it.sehri "Iftar" it.iftar it.note faint
    if(it.roza, "Roza", "Missed") bold color if(it.roza, good, bad)
"Total roza kept" count(day where roza = yes) head
"Total missed" count(day where roza = no) head
"Days missed:" head
each day where roza = no sort d
  it.d
describe:
Ramadan Planner, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- day: d: date; sehri: time of day; iftar: time of day; "Roza kept": yes or no, starts at yes; "Taraweeh rakaat": number, 0 to 20, starts at 8; note: text, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- a form to add a day.
- for each day sorted by d:
  - a group; a tap opens the day for editing:
    - text: its d.
    - text: "Sehri", its sehri, "Iftar", its iftar, its note.
    - text: "Roza" when its roza, otherwise "Missed".
- text: "Total roza kept", how many day entries where roza is yes.
- text: "Total missed", how many day entries where roza is no.
- text: "Days missed:".
- for each day where roza is no sorted by d:
  - text: its d.

program:
app "Nursing" baby plum
table nurse side pick Left|Right, mins num 1..90 = 10
let nextside = if(last(nurse.side) = Left, "Right", "Left")
"Start with" nextside big
count(nurse today) "feeds today," sum(nurse.mins today) "minutes" faint
"Last feed" hour(now - last(nurse.at)) "h" minute(now - last(nurse.at)) "min ago" faint
row gap 1
  each options nurse.side
    button it grow tap add nurse side = it
list nurse last 3 days by day
describe:
Nursing, in the plum colours.
Keeps:
- nurse: side: one of Left, Right; mins: number, 1 to 90, starts at 10. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- nextside is "Right" when the latest side of nurse is Left, otherwise "Left".
Shows:
- text: "Start with", nextside.
- text: how many nurse entries today, "feeds today,", the total mins of nurse today, "minutes".
- text: "Last feed", the hour of now minus the latest at of nurse, "h", the minute of now minus the latest at of nurse, "min ago".
- for each choice of the side of the nurse:
  - a button the choice; a tap adds a nurse with side set to the choice.
- a list of nurse in the last 3 days by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
